id: The Taking of Pelham One Two Three (1974)

ops.old: Paper-thin lavash brushed with oil, salt and sesame, baked crisp and snapped into shards, with lemony whipped feta for dipping. Brush 4 sheets lavash with 3 tbsp olive oil, sprinkle with 2 tbsp sesame seeds and flaky salt. Bake at 180C for 8 minutes until crisp, cool and snap into shards. Blitz 200g feta with 100g Greek yoghurt, the zest of 1 lemon, 1 tbsp lemon juice and 2 tbsp olive oil until smooth. Spoon into a bowl, drizzle with oil and scatter with chilli flakes.
